2610.09938.title: Fast holographic inversion of superconducting domes
2610.09938.paper_summary: A holographic superconductor whose scalar mass depends on the gauge field strength, $M(\Fsq)$, reproduces a superconducting dome for a suitable $M$, and recovering that $M$ from a given dome has so far taken days for a single training run. We propose a new way of training this model, with which an inversion takes from about ten minutes to an hour. Training needs the gradient of the condition that fixes the critical temperature, which the earlier method obtains by finite differences, repeating the bulk integrations for every training parameter. Here that condition is obtained, without any fit, from two integrations started at the horizon and at the boundary, and its derivative with respect to $M$ is an integral over the same two solutions, so the gradient needs no integration of its own. We use the speed to study the part of $M$ that a dome cannot determine, on the interval between the value $\Fsq$ takes at the horizon for the lowest doping and $\Fsq=0$, at which $M$ is the scalar mass $M(0)$ that fixes the dimension of the dual operator. We hold the scalar mass at several values, which we call pinned masses, retrain everything else at each, and find that the reconstructions agree wherever the horizons of the dome reach, including the minima of $M$, and differ only on that interval. A rule that keeps the reconstruction with the simplest closed form recovers both the scalar mass and the mass function of a test dome. On Gaussian and double-Gaussian domes and on the measured phase diagrams of YBa$_{2}$Cu$_{3}$O$_{y}$ and 2M-WS$_{2}$, however, the pinned mass it keeps rests on ties or on narrow margins, so for these targets the scalar mass is left open. The dome thus constrains $M$ where its horizons reach, and fixing the dimension of the dual operator needs a second observable.
2610.09938.paper_summary_zh: 一種全息超導體，其標量質量依賴於規範場強度 $M(\Fsq)$，為合適的 $M$ 重現一個超導圓頂，而從給定的圓頂恢復該 $M$ 至今需要幾天的時間來進行一次訓練。 我們提出了一種新的訓練方法，通過這種方法，反演大約需要十分鐘到一小時。 訓練需要固定臨界溫度的條件的梯度，而早期的方法通過有限差分獲得這一條件，對每個訓練參數重複進行體積積分。 在這裡，該條件是從兩個從地平線和邊界開始的積分中獲得的，且其對 $M$ 的導數是對同兩個解的積分，因此梯度不需要自己的積分。 我們利用這一速度來研究圓頂無法確定的 $M$ 部分，這一區間位於地平線上最低摻雜的 $\Fsq$ 值和 $\Fsq=0$ 之間，在此 $M$ 是固定對偶算子的維度的標量質量 $M(0)$。 我們將標量質量保持在幾個值上，我們稱之為固定質量，並在每個值上重新訓練其他所有內容，發現重建在圓頂的地平線達到的地方一致，包括 $M$ 的最小值，並且僅在該區間內有所不同。 一條保持重建以最簡閉合形式的規則同時恢復了標量質量和測試圓頂的質量函數。 然而，在高斯和雙高斯圓頂以及 YBa$_{2}$Cu$_{3}$O$_{y}$ 和 2M-WS$_{2}$ 的測量相圖上，所保持的固定質量則依賴於聯繫或狹窄的邊際，因此對於這些目標，標量質量仍然保持開放。 因此，圓頂在其地平線達到的地方約束了 $M$，而固定對偶算子的維度需要第二個可觀測量。
